# AppDimens Games 3.0 — LLM index
# Family: appdimens (hub) · appdimens-dynamic 3.x (Android) · appdimens-kmp 1.x (KMP) · appdimens-games 3.0 (GAMES)
# API vocabulary is IDENTICAL across the family (stems/suffixes/facilitators/builders).
# Math is bit-parity everywhere. Constants: W0=300, H0=533, diag0=611.6305 (family literal,
# true sqrt=611.628155…), perim0=833, ARref=1.78, inv300=1/300, ADJ=0.10/30, K=0.08/30.

## Toolchain
AGP 9.x · Kotlin 2.x · Gradle 9.1 · compileSdk 37 · minSdk 24 · JDK 17

## Artifacts (version 3.0.0)
io.github.bodenberg:appdimens-games (core) + -auto -density -diagonal -fill -fit -fluid
-interpolated -logarithmic -percent -perimeter -power -resize -units -native + -bom

## Kotlin/Java code API (returns PX)
Int/Float extensions: sdp sdpa sdpi sdpia · hdp hdpa hdpi hdpia · wdp wdpa wdpi wdpia (+Px variants)
Text: ssp sspa sspi sspia · hsp wsp · sem hem wem (fixed)
Inverters (family naming): sdpPh sdpLh sdpPw sdpLw · hdpLw hdpPw · wdpLh wdpPh
Facilitators: Number.sdpRotate / .sdpMode / .sdpQualifier / .sdpScreen
Builder: Number.scaledDp() → DimenScaled (.aspectRatio/.ignoreMultiWindows/.screen/.qualifier/.orientation → .sdp(ctx)|.dp(ctx))
Java facade: DimenSdp.{sdp,sdpa,sdpi,sdpia,hdp,hdpi,wdp,wdpi}(ctx,v), getDimensionInPx/Dp(...), scaled(v), warmupCache()
Escape hatch: Number.toDynamicScaledDp/Px(context, qualifier, inverter, ignoreMultiWindows, applyAspectRatio, customSensitivityK)
Deprecated 2.x gateway names → com.appdimens.games.compat.GamesCompat (migration only)

## Compose API (@get:Composable)
Provider: AppDimensProvider { } · Locals: LocalDimenMetrics, LocalUiModeType · currentDimenMetrics()
Number.sdp/.sdpa/.sdpi/.sdpia : Dp · Number.sdpPx/.sdpaPx/.sdpiPx : Float
hdp/hdpa/hdpi(+Px) · wdp/wdpa/wdpi(+Px) · Text: Number.ssp/.sspi : TextUnit · Number.semPx : Float

## Satellite prefixes (code+compose, suffixes a/i/ia)
psdp phdp pwdp + spaceW/Sw/H(i) · pwsdp · fsdp · asdp (gameplay ⭐) · dgsdp · flsdp · ftsdp ·
isdp · logsdp · prsdp · dsdp

## Resize semantics
Default values auto-adjust on window resize via GameScreen live snapshot.
Suffix `i` = ignoreMultiWindows → invariant: anchored to frozen FULLSCREEN metrics;
under true multi-window returns base value (family parity). `a` = 1+K·ln((max/min)/1.78).

## Engine wiring (non-Compose)
Activity/Surface/Vulkan: GameScreen.updateFromContext(context[, fullscreen]) per resize/config change.

## Native engines
C++20 header-only: namespace appdimens::games — Metrics::make + updateMetrics + metrics()/invariantMetrics();
math::{scaledDp,scaledArDp,widthDp,heightDp,calculateScaledDp,percentOfAxisDp,powerDp,fluidDp,autoDp,
logarithmicDp,interpolatedDp,diagonalDp,perimeterDp,fitDp,fillDp,densityDp,toPx,scaleVecFit};
render::{viewportRect,glRect,vkViewport,dxViewport,ortho}. Field-compatible with VkViewport/D3D11_VIEWPORT.
Pure C99 single header: c/appdimens_games_c.h (adg_*).
JNI bridge: com.appdimens.games.jni.NativeBridge.{updateMetrics,scaled,scaledAr,scaledInvariant,power,fluid,auto,logarithmic,diagonal,fit,fill,toPx}

ScaledInvariant/Auto/Fluid/Fit/Fill/…) · World.ViewportRect(mode,w,h,dw,dh) · Units.CmToPx…
